instructions.name: add_asset
docs: Direct (timelock must be 0). Otherwise queue ACTION_ADD_ASSET.

instructions.name: begin_remove_asset
docs: Direct (timelock must be 0). Otherwise queue ACTION_BEGIN_REMOVE_ASSET.

instructions.name: cancel_action
docs: Authority.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: `gross_amount` defaults to `required[slot]`; Token-2022 fee mints need a gross whose net
(after the transfer fee) is >= required, otherwise `ShortDeposit`.

instructions.name: execute_action
docs: Anyone, after eta. Every kind except ADD_ASSET / SET_TOKEN_METADATA (which have their own ixs).

accounts.name: asset
docs: Required for SET_TARGET_WEIGHT / REF_PRICE_OVERRIDE / BEGIN_REMOVE_ASSET.

instructions.name: execute_action_add_asset
docs: Anyone, after eta. ADD_ASSET only (creates the Asset PDA and vault ATA).

instructions.name: fill_auction
docs: `gross_buy_amount` defaults to the price-implied buy amount; the buy vault must receive at
least that much (`ShortFill` otherwise), so a fee on the buy token is paid by the filler.

accounts.name: filler_sell_token
docs: Filler's account that receives the sold tokens.

accounts.name: filler_buy_token
docs: Filler's account that pays the bought tokens (filler must be its authority).

instructions.name: queue_action
docs: Authority. Creates PendingAction ["pending", fund, action_nonce] with eta = now + timelock.

instructions.name: set_auction_params
docs: Direct (timelock must be 0): max_auction_discount_bps, max_ref_move_bps, ref_move_period_slots.

instructions.name: set_fee_recipient
docs: Direct (timelock must be 0). Otherwise queue ACTION_SET_FEE_RECIPIENT.

instructions.name: set_fees
docs: Direct (timelock must be 0). Otherwise queue ACTION_SET_FEES.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Protective; never timelocked.

instructions.name: set_rebalancer
docs: Direct (timelock must be 0). Otherwise queue ACTION_SET_REBALANCER.

instructions.name: set_ref_price
docs: Rebalancer or authority. Q64.64 numeraire per raw base unit.

instructions.name: set_target_weight
docs: Direct (timelock must be 0). Otherwise queue ACTION_SET_TARGET_WEIGHT.

instructions.name: set_timelock
docs: Enables the timelock while it is 0. Changing it afterwards requires ACTION_SET_TIMELOCK.

instructions.name: set_token_metadata
docs: Metaplex metadata (name / symbol / uri) for the index mint, created or updated through the
fund PDA (mint + update authority). Direct while the timelock is 0; otherwise pass the due
ACTION_SET_TOKEN_METADATA action (key = token_metadata_hash) and its proposer.

accounts.name: action
docs: Required while the timelock is armed: a due ACTION_SET_TOKEN_METADATA whose key is the payload hash.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The sell asset's vault (checked against sell_asset.vault via has_one).

errors.name: AuctionsOpen
errors.msg: Cannot begin mint while auctions are open

errors.name: StaleEpoch
errors.msg: Fund epoch changed since session began

errors.name: IncompleteDeposits
errors.msg: Not every active slot has been deposited

errors.name: IncompleteWithdrawals
errors.msg: Not every entitled slot has been withdrawn

errors.name: WrongRemainingAccounts
errors.msg: Remaining accounts do not match the fund's active slots

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: AssetNotEmpty
errors.msg: Asset vault is not empty or has pending balances

errors.name: WrongAssetStatus
errors.msg: Asset is not in the expected status

errors.name: SessionNotReady
errors.msg: Session is not ready (begin chunks incomplete)

errors.name: RefPriceUnset
errors.msg: Reference price not set for an auction asset

errors.name: RefPriceMoveTooLarge
errors.msg: Reference price move exceeds max_ref_move_bps for this period

errors.name: PriceBelowBound
errors.msg: Auction end price is below the reference-price bound

errors.name: TimelockRequired
errors.msg: Timelock is enabled; queue this change with queue_action

errors.name: TimelockNotElapsed
errors.msg: Pending action eta has not elapsed

errors.name: WrongActionKind
errors.msg: Pending action kind does not match this instruction

errors.name: WrongActionTarget
errors.msg: Account does not match the pending action payload

errors.name: ShortDeposit
errors.msg: Vault received less than the required deposit (transfer fee?); send a larger gross_amount

errors.name: ShortFill
errors.msg: Buy vault received less than the auction price (transfer fee?); send a larger gross_buy_amount

types.name: Asset
docs: A constituent. PDA: ["asset", fund, mint].

fields.name: vault
docs: ATA(fund PDA, mint)

fields.name: index
docs: slot 0..511

fields.name: status
docs: 0 = Active, 1 = Removing

fields.name: pending_deposits
docs: tokens sitting in vault from unfinalized mint sessions (excluded from NAV).
Credited with the amount the vault actually received (balance delta), so it can never
exceed `vault.amount` even for Token-2022 fee-on-transfer mints.

fields.name: pending_withdrawals
docs: tokens reserved by open redeem sessions (excluded from NAV)

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump, lets begin_mint/redeem verify Asset PDAs with create_program_address

fields.name: ref_price
docs: Reference price, Q64.64, fund numeraire per raw base unit of the token
(off-chain convention: numeraire = 1e-9 USD). 0 = unset (auctions on this asset are blocked).

fields.name: ref_price_anchor
docs: ref_price at the start of the current move window; the move cap is measured against it.

types.name: Auction
docs: Dutch auction. PDA: ["auction", fund, auction_nonce_le].

fields.name: sell_asset
docs: Asset PDA being sold from vault

fields.name: buy_asset
docs: Asset PDA being bought into vault

fields.name: start_price
docs: buy_token per sell_token, Q64.64 — decays linearly to end_price

fields.name: status
docs: 0 open, 1 filled, 2 cancelled, 3 expired

fields.name: nonce
docs: fund.auction_nonce at creation (seed). Appended to the spec layout.

types.name: Fund
docs: The fund. PDA: ["fund", index_mint].

fields.name: active_bitmap
docs: bit i set if asset slot i is Active (participates in mint/redeem).

fields.name: epoch
docs: Increments on every auction fill; invalidates open mint sessions.

fields.name: paused
docs: bit0 = mint paused, bit1 = redeem paused, bit2 = auctions paused.

fields.name: occupied_bitmap
docs: bit i set if asset slot i is occupied by an Asset account (Active or Removing).

fields.name: max_auction_discount_bps
docs: Auction `end_price` may not be more than this far below the ref-price fair value.

fields.name: max_ref_move_bps
docs: Rebalancer ref-price updates may move at most this far from the period anchor.

fields.name: ref_move_period_slots
docs: Length of the ref-price move window in slots.

fields.name: timelock_slots
docs: Admin timelock in slots (0 = direct admin ixs allowed; localnet/tests).

fields.name: action_nonce
docs: Next PendingAction nonce.

types.name: MintSession
docs: In-kind creation session. PDA: ["mint_session", fund, owner, nonce_le].
Zero-copy (4.2 KB): `required` has one u64 per slot.

fields.name: units
docs: index units requested (gross, before fee)

fields.name: epoch
docs: fund.epoch at begin; finalize requires equality

fields.name: next_slot
docs: Chunked begin: the next active slot to compute `required` for. Slots below are done.

fields.name: ready
docs: 1 once every active slot has been computed (gates deposit / finalize).

fields.name: required
docs: per-slot required deposit, computed at begin (possibly over several chunks).
`deposit` overwrites the slot with the amount the vault actually received (>= required),
which is what `finalize_mint` / `cancel_mint_refund` release from `pending_deposits`.

types.name: PendingAction
docs: Timelocked admin action. PDA: ["pending", fund, nonce_le].

fields.name: key
docs: Pubkey payload (asset mint / new rebalancer / new fee recipient), kind-dependent.

fields.name: values
docs: Numeric payload, kind-dependent (see ACTION_* docs).

types.name: RedeemSession
docs: In-kind redemption session. PDA: ["redeem_session", fund, owner, nonce_le].

fields.name: units
docs: net units burned

fields.name: entitled
docs: per-slot amount owed, computed & reserved at begin (possibly over several chunks)

fields.name: created
docs: true when the metadata account was created, false when it was updated.
